inputs: A captured IngestionEnvelope with platform, URL, date, method, evidence pointer and public payload
A batch objective, BatchBudget, queries and stop conditions agreed before collection
A researcher's screening signals, recommendation, reason and review date
invariants: No network, scraper, downloader, browser or model runs here: ingestion accepts captured metadata and the package remains isolated from production.
Unknown payload keys and private channel analytics are refused, not dropped or fabricated.
A URL is canonicalized or rejected; candidate identity is platform plus external id, never a title.
Repeated discovery unions provenance without replacing known values or reviving a screened-out candidate.
Only a person screens, and only a screened-in candidate may be handed to the core ResearchSource contract.
A batch declares budget and stop conditions before collection; a breached ceiling stops work until a named authoriser escalates it.
Round logs and public snapshots are chronological and append-only; missing observations remain missing.
Saturation needs the configured number of measured rounds; insufficient evidence is distinct from not saturated.
outputs: DiscoveryQuery and deduplicated DiscoveryCandidate with complete provenance
SnapshotSeries of dated public observations and supported derived rates
ScreeningAssessment and an ordered queue with explicit coverage
ResearchBatch with append-only rounds, consumption and triggered stop conditions
ResearchResourceRecord with optional measured costs and units
BatchReport with funnel, duplication, concentration, saturation and missing measurements
purpose: Owns the bounded research operations that turn captured public metadata into screened handoffs: ingestion, discovery, snapshots, batch control, resource accounting, saturation measurement and stop-rule enforcement.
risks: Public metrics are dated observations, never permanent properties of a video.
Deduplication depends on platform identity; canonical URL is only the fallback when no external id exists.
Saturation reflects only recorded rounds and known creator identities.
Absent resource measurements make totals and cost-per-outcome unknowable rather than zero.
title: Research operations
